metadata.description: The product-side skills for the Monterro product development process.

plugins.name: monterro-product-process
plugins.description: Product-side workflow: from a queue of customer signals or a PM's own idea to a Product Ticket engineering can pick up. Synthesis per channel, a cross-source pass, signal triage, the two authoring entrances, the discovery helpers, both gates (the readiness gate and handover triage), and the spec review after the build.
